name: k8s_storage_class
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes StorageClass. A StorageClass is a cluster-scoped object that describes how a volume is dynamically provisioned; PersistentVolumeClaims reference it by name.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this storage class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the storage class. Must be a DNS-1123 subdomain (lowercase alphanumeric, '-' and '.', starting and ending with an alphanumeric).

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this storage class to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this storage class belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group (EKS cluster) this storage class belongs to.

attributes.name: storage_provisioner
attributes.description: The volume plugin used to provision PersistentVolumes, e.g. "ebs.csi.aws.com" or "efs.csi.aws.com". Immutable: changing it replaces the storage class. (Named storage_provisioner because 'provisioner' is a reserved Terraform block name.)

attributes.name: parameters
attributes.description: Provisioner-specific parameters, e.g. {"type" = "gp3", "encrypted" = "true"}. Immutable in Kubernetes: changing it replaces the storage class.

attributes.name: reclaim_policy
attributes.description: Reclaim policy for PersistentVolumes created from this class: Delete (default) or Retain. Immutable.

attributes.name: volume_binding_mode
attributes.description: When volumes are bound and provisioned: Immediate (default) or WaitForFirstConsumer (delays binding until a Pod using the claim is scheduled). Immutable.

attributes.name: allow_volume_expansion
attributes.description: Whether PersistentVolumeClaims using this class may be expanded. Immutable.

attributes.name: mount_options
attributes.description: Mount options for PersistentVolumes created from this class. Immutable.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the storage class. Send-only: the server injects its own duplocloud.ai/* labels, so this value is not read back to avoid spurious drift.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the storage class, e.g. {"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class" = "true"}. Send-only (not read back).
